measurements.evidence_quote: Both the florescent and non-florescent PS-NPs were spherical monodisperse nanoparticles, which were colloidally stable in both the Milli-Q water and DMEN/F12 medium (Fig. S1). || They had hydrodynamic diameters (Dh) of approximately 45–68 nm and negative ζ potential values near -30 mV. || The PS-NPs were prepared in the DMEM/F12 cell culture medium (C11330500BT, Gibco, USA) for intervening the MN9D cells and Milli-Q water for mice gavage. || The hydrodynamic diameters (Dh) and zeta (ζ) potentials of PS-NPs in these two suspensions were characterized using the Zetasizer Nano ZS90 (Malvern, UK) (Fig. S1), as described in Text S1.1.
measurements.evidence_location: Results para 1; Methods, Preparation and characterization of PS-NPs
